maddeler.e:
أزدهف (form VIII)
# أَزْدَهِفُ (ʔazdahifu) /ʔaz.da.hi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# أُزْدَهَفُ (ʔuzdahafu) /ʔuz.da.ha.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# أَزْدَهِفَ (ʔazdahifa) /ʔaz.da.hi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# أُزْدَهَفَ (ʔuzdahafa) /ʔuz.da.ha
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
